The '''Mission to Utapau''' was a trap set up by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] leadership to assassinate Sith scientist [[Vul Isen]], who was responsible for the [[Genocide on Dac]] and the [[Devastation of Da Soocha]]. They hired [[Cade Skywalker]] and his team, who were already hunting down Isen, to kill him. Ultimately, Cade was successful in killing Isen.
